name: argyronix-lorm
description: The reference implementation of LORM, the Layered Operational Responsibility Model — a specification that grades an agent's authority to act by who authorized the action. One plugin: the agent skill and the enforcement hooks that make the authorization boundary deterministic.

plugins.name: lorm
plugins.description: Authorization gate and audit trail for agent actions: what a written policy grants runs, what it does not requires approval, what it forbids is denied.
